What Quesma sells

  • Quesma coding-agent analytics: Analyzes coding-agent sessions and costs. The product page offers installers and a self-service app link; the homepage still says early access opens soon.
  • Quesma Shipper: An open-source collector that removes secrets and encrypts coding-agent sessions before uploading them to configured cloud storage.
  • CompileBench / OTelBench / BinaryAudit / BabaIsBench: These four benchmarks (shared tests for comparing model performance) cover specific engineering or puzzle tasks.
